scope: PROP-FLOOD-06.v5 (registry/proposals/flood_outlet_coping.json): one method-domain (M) proposal for a community flood-readout application (FloodConnect), via the governed proposals-lane intake process -- NOT promoted into registry/CANONICAL.json. Builds on the v4 ACK (promoters-as-floor-under-every-mode, the inseparable readout record -- unchanged by this pass except where explicitly amended below). This v5 pass is driven by a founder instruction (verbatim, 2026-09-27: "ถึงจะแม่นยำและใช้ได้กับทุกสถานที่") and thailand_flood_kg's second read-only falsifier backtest (BACKTEST_PROP_FLOOD_06_v1.md, RELAYED, not conducted by this proposal), which found v4's REFUSED-share fix worked (92.5%->0.9% across the two backtests) but the surviving readouts still fire LATE or NOT AT ALL against real ground truth: Hat Yai (X.44, a real gauge) never crossed L3 across two full real events (2553, 2565); Nan (N.1) first-warned -48h (2 days after onset); Chiang Mai (P.1) 0h (simultaneous); only Ayutthaya (upstream-inflow-dominated by construction) got real lead time (+264h, GloFAS-relayed), at a 51.6% false-alarm rate and S_H ranges overlapping heavily between flooded/non-flooded days. Root cause identified: every v4 cov(U) component is IN-UNIT, rising together with the flood rather than ahead of it. v5 AMENDMENTS: (1) three LEADING coverage components added, widening cov(U) to cov5(U) from 7 to 10 (>=9 required): upstream_rise_rate (PROP-FLOOD-01's lag-k Delta_k(t) RISING classification applied to a declared UPSTREAM gauge's own series, not U's -- new Toledo parent citation added to this proposal's JSON parents array, previously only in MD prose), basin_rain_accum (24h/72h rain over A_U's upstream sub-basin, gauges+ERA5/IMERG RELAYED), forecast_rain_72h (ensemble median/max over the next 72h at the upstream sub-basin). A declared per-unit travel time tau_up(U) (hours, OPEN-until-measured) shifts the upstream series so a crossing detected on it is a genuine advance warning; candidate upstream gauges are declared per unit (N.64 for Nan, CONFIRMED present in thailand_flood_kg DATA_SWEEP_2026-09-27.md; P.67/P.75 for Chiang Mai, X.90/X.173 for Hat Yai, C.2 for Ayutthaya -- all UNCONFIRMED to exist in this repository's own knowledge base and explicitly NOT asserted to exist, per the founder's own conditional framing "if they exist"). (2) Three new promoters (UPSTREAM_RISE_RATE_EXCEEDS L3, BASIN_RAIN_ACCUM_EXCEEDS L2, FORECAST_RAIN_72H_EXCEEDS L1, the last deliberately lowest since it is the only forward-looking/not-yet-observed term) compose into the existing v4 promoter-max floor unchanged -- no new mode-selection logic. A new refusal code, UPSTREAM_GAUGE_UNDECLARED, is scoped ONLY to the leading term (refuses that term alone, never the whole unit), consistent with v3/v4's graceful-degradation discipline. (3) lead_time_h field: PROP-FLOOD-02 reused a SECOND time (T_act_upstream), applied to the tau_up-shifted upstream series with the upstream gauge's own declared threshold -- a genuinely distinct instantiation from T_act(U) itself (unchanged, still on U's own in-unit series). (4) A per-unit calibration_procedure is declared as a falsifier discipline (not a fit claiming truth): finite predeclared candidate grid (all Q), maximise hits subject to a declared max-false-alarm-rate ceiling, MEASURED-on-backtest, append-only version list, and an explicit prohibition on re-calibrating against the same already-fitted data twice -- only a genuinely NEW observed event licenses recalibration. A new calibrated:yes(n_events,hit,FA,median_lead_h)|no readout field is added; every unit named in this registration (Hat Yai, Nan, Chiang Mai, Ayutthaya, Bangkok East) reports calibrated:no (national defaults, unchanged S_H/T_act/promoter threshold VALUES) -- recorded in a new top-level per_unit_calibration JSON block stating what is/isn't confirmed per unit. (5) A hysteresis/persistence rule is declared: a raise requires p=2 (default) consecutive raw hourly readouts, a lowering requires q=3 (default), both OPEN-for-founder-tuning -- explicitly trading lead time for false-alarm rate, both to be reported together in any backtest of it, never one alone. Coq (coq/canonical/PROP_FLOOD_06_outlet_coping_tier.v): coverage_vector_v5/readout_v5 EXTEND v4's coverage_vector/readout by embedding (v4's own record types, functions, and all 39 v4 theorems are UNCHANGED and still hold verbatim, not touched by this pass); full_tier_v5 re-derives totality, coverage_total_v5=10 (and >=9), coverage_present_v5<=10, LR-iff-coverage-present_v5-is-0, and the two v4-style monotonicity theorems (full_tier_v5_promoter_monotone, full_tier_v5_full_ge_partial) over the widened vector and the concatenated base+leading promoter lists, via new generic helper lemmas (promoters_mono_app, applies_base_mono_v5, applies_leading_mono_v5); persisted (a hysteresis state machine over a raw per-hour tier sequence) and persisted_is_some_historical_raw prove persistence with p,q>=1 never reports a tier absent from the raw (un-persisted) history at some hour <= n -- it can only delay a raise/lowering the raw rule already produced, never fabricate one. A separate founder instruction, received during this same registration, asks for a THIRD coverage state (`inferred`, derived from anchor-consistency rules, with an ordinal confidence field and a third monotonicity theorem) -- this is deliberately deferred to v6 as a genuinely new primitive requiring its own Toledo-first lookup/Genesis-compatibility pass before derivation, not rushed into this v5 commit; recorded as an explicit v6 TODO in the JSON's honest_caveats, the MD, and the Coq file's closing v5 comment. No S_H/T_act/promoter threshold VALUE from v1-v4 is changed by this v5 pass -- this is a structural addition (leading inputs, a calibration procedure, a hysteresis rule), not a retune; no unit is actually calibrated by this registration. No claim about the Clay Millennium Navier-Stokes problem, or about any object's Clay/NS status, is made or implied anywhere in this change; the status of every existing Clay-related registry object (CANONICAL.json, coq/canonical/ pre-existing files, docs/CLAY_*) is unchanged.
